title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30
lineage: Master Reel > Reel >Dat > WAV > FLAC (Reel labeled: through the Debbie connection: P.A.  Harmon Kardon; probably recorded from the soundboard)

ai_review.summary: Cleaned‑up audience tape captures a solid summer ’73 show with a monster Eyes of the World and crisp Sugar Magnolia.
ai_review.review: The taper’s cleanup work shines through, delivering an audience recording that sounds clearer than most Dead auds on the archive. The performance itself is praised for its strong setlist – highlighted by a 19‑minute “Eyes of the World,” lively “Cumberland Blues,” and a classic “Sugar Magnolia.” Overall the show feels like a quintessential summer ’73 experience.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are highly positive (average 4.7 stars) and specifically commend both the musical set and the improved audio quality, indicating a strong show with an above‑average recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Taper’s cleanup work makes the tape sound clearer than most audience recordings; crisp overall with no major issues noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A solid summer ’73 set that balances tight mid‑tempo numbers with extended jams, keeping the energy high throughout both sets.
